credit_policy: All automated cases use local fakes and zero-cost fixtures. No Varoriya request or real credential is permitted.

gates.title: Typecheck, build, and automated test suite
gates.command: cd server && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
gates.acceptance: zero failures, zero skipped cases, zero unfinished cases

gates.title: Release harness and package validation
gates.acceptance: all release cases pass and machine-readable validation returns ok=true

gates.title: Dependency and secret hygiene
gates.acceptance: no high or critical vulnerability and no credential finding in the release bundle

gates.title: MCP Inspector interoperability evidence
gates.acceptance: initialize, tools/list, public list_models, protected auth challenge, quote, confirm, generate, and get_job evidence captured without exposing secrets

gates.title: API Playground protocol and schema evidence
gates.acceptance: HTTP status, JSON-RPC envelope, schemas, annotations, auth boundary, and error mapping recorded against the deployed HTTPS endpoint

gates.title: ChatGPT developer-mode connection evidence
gates.acceptance: plugin connects through public HTTPS OAuth metadata and completes a zero-credit sandbox generation or approved provider test

gates.title: Varoriya OAuth-to-REST sandbox contract validation
gates.acceptance: real provider OAuth token, quote, upload, generation, polling, and ownership behavior verified in an approved sandbox

gates.title: Security, privacy, terms, and directory submission approval
gates.acceptance: authorized reviewer signs evidence, risk acceptance, privacy/terms URLs, rollback plan, and directory submission decision
